definitions.gloss: close, intimate, closely connected, closely related
definitions.explanation: Having a very close connection or relationship between things, concepts, or people. Often used to describe abstract relationships rather than physical proximity.

examples.japanese: {密接|みっせつ}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{密接|みっせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結|むす}びついている→結びつく：13797_musubitsuku⟧。
examples.english: The economy and the environment are closely linked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{密接|みっせつ}な{関|かか}わり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Diet and health are closely related, and daily meals greatly affect one's physical condition.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used for abstract relationships between concepts, fields, or organizations rather than physical closeness. The adverbial form {密接|みっせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is very common. During the COVID-19 pandemic, {密接|みっせつ} gained additional prominence as one of the "three Cs" (⟦{三密|さんみつ}→三密：28366_sanmitsu⟧): ⟦{密閉|みっぺい}→密閉：19651_mippei⟧ (enclosed spaces), ⟦{密集|みっしゅう}→密集：12342_misshuu⟧ (crowded places), and {密接|みっせつ} (close contact).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {密接|みっせつ}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: close relationship
- {密接|みっせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かか}わる→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧: to be closely involved
- {密接|みっせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結|むす}びつく→結びつく：13797_musubitsuku⟧: to be closely linked
- {密接|みっせつ}な⟦{連携|れんけい}→連携：05094_renkei⟧: close cooperation
- {密接|みっせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}する→関連する：17848_kanrensuru⟧: to be closely related
